subject: Expansion sprint discount timetable and co-term alignment
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@vaultmed.ai>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion sprint — urgent uplift + co-term ask

Hi Chloe,

Quick context: VaultMed is planning an internal ‘expansion sprint’ to accelerate new features in July. We expect a 1.3–1.6x bump in generation usage for ~8–12 weeks. We want to keep latency SLAs but need a short-term commercial path so we can proceed without procurement delays.

Asks:
- Can Redwood provide a temporary sprint discount for the increased usage window (July–Sept)?
- Can we co-term the uplift into our existing annual contract (current renewal: 2027-10-31) so billing aligns?
- We’re happy to consider a commitment for a smaller annual uplift if you can offer a deeper short-term discount.

I attached our Q1 usage export for line-item estimates.

Thanks — can you loop in pricing/renewals? We need a commercial answer before our engineering kickoff on 6/15.

— Alex
Product Ops, VaultMed AI
[Attachment: usage_report_q1.csv (CSV)]

From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@vaultmed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion sprint — urgent uplift + co-term ask

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the usage file. Quick answers and a proposed path so your team can proceed with the July kickoff: 

Proposal (high level):
- Short-term sprint discount: 30% off unit price for the incremental usage above your baseline for a fixed 90-day window (start 2027-07-01, end 2027-09-28).
- Co-term: We can co-term the incremental uplift to your existing renewal date (2027-10-31) and offer an annualized credit if you convert to a committed uplift at renewal.
- Commit incentive: If VaultMed commits to >=1.2x baseline as a 12-month uplift at renewal, we’ll apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the sprint-discounted overage billed.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ben — can you confirm if 30% short-term discount sits within quota for our current fiscal incentives, and whether Legal needs to touch the wording in the amendment?
2) Rishi — FYI on the commit-incentive structure (we may need leadership signoff if credit > standard thresholds).
3) Alex — if this headline works, I’ll circulate a contract amendment (pro-rate language + sprint banding) and a DocuSign for signature.

Can you confirm the baseline you want us to use (30-day trailing avg or last billing period)? I used your Q1 export to run a quick proxy but want you to sign off on baseline definition before we lock the credit math.

Cheers,
Chloe
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: VaultMed sprint commercial — proposal and ask

Ben / Rishi — moving this through quickly for a July start. Key points below (summary for approval):

Commercials proposed to VaultMed (summary):
- Sprint discount: 30% off unit generation price for incremental usage above baseline, duration 90 days (2027-07-01 to 2027-09-28).
- Baseline: 30-day trailing average ending 2027-05-31 (per customer request; they confirmed the file).
- Co-term: Incremental usage will be billed as overage during sprint; if they commit to >=1.2x baseline at renewal (10/31/2027) we’ll convert those overages into a committed uplift and apply a credit equal to 50% of the sprint-discounted overage billed. Credit issued as invoice credit within 30 days of new PO.
- Limits: Cap sprint-eligible incremental billable at 1.6x baseline to prevent runaway exposure.

Risks / asks:
- The 50% conversion credit is above standard; need leadership signoff if >$75k credit exposure.
- Legal: need an amendment that covers pro-rata billing, conversion credit mechanics, and an audit right on usage to validate baseline.

Attachments for review: contract_draft_v2.pdf (I’ll include the sprint banding clause).

If we can lock at 30% / 90 days and get Rishi OK on the credit cap, I’ll send the external amendment and a DocuSign. Timetable: need approval by EOD 2027-06-14 to meet their procurement window.

Thanks — Chloe

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@vaultmed.ai>
Cc: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion sprint — urgent uplift + co-term ask

Alex — good news. We can approve the sprint package with the following confirmed terms: 

Final commercial terms: 
- Sprint discount: 30% off incremental usage above baseline for 90 days (2027-07-01 to 2027-09-28).
- Baseline definition: 30-day trailing average ending 2027-05-31 (per your file).
- Co-term & conversion credit: If VaultMed commits at renewal to >=1.2x baseline for 12 months, we will apply a credit equal to 50% of the sprint-discounted overage you were billed. Credit will be issued as an invoice credit within 30 days of receipt of signed PO.
- Cap: Sprint-eligible incremental usage will be capped at 1.6x baseline for billing.

Next steps:
1) Connector: I’ve attached the amendment (contract_draft_v2.pdf) and created a DocuSign envelope so we can execute quickly.
2) Please review the amendment, confirm baseline acceptance, and sign via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

If you sign before 2027-07-01 we’ll ensure the sprint window is backdated to the requested start.

Thanks and excited to support the sprint — Ben
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
